### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the deposit": the hub sentence forbids working out the deposit before the new-room span exists; and the deposit-tier factor reads the latest span, so without the span the tier reverts to the admission tier.
- Closest alternatives excluded: recorded move date 10-06 vs requested 10-08 (room_change_move_date dearer-room rule, request record); preceding vs current schedule for the new room (requested move → current); room-change credit vs no credit (no conversion recorded, so the "Conversion months" exclusion does not apply); late-notice credit owed on the new-room span? (late_rate_notice_credit: a span for a room the resident asked to move into "is owed no late-notice credit" — and the order puts the credit on the advance first); insurer window (07-03 payment is 3 whole months + days back → excluded, leaving exactly three → "three or more" row).
- Wording note: recurring-services rule 2 "the recurring charges of the latest service month billed (the one posted first where two share a posting date)" — the parenthetical reads as a single-entry tie-break; here only one recurring charge (telephone) sits in 2026-09, so no effect in this world.
